CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation bound to identified content/time was found.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red positions), an explicit presentation (the position set) and a separate origin/status field are present for the same candidate referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim is linked to the identified content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color-labeled sets) with their position attributes are listed.

D.rationale: Each content entry is accompanied by a separate origin/status field (e.g. command_estimate/history_estimate), distinguishing identification from its source/status.

O.rationale: The report explicitly shows how content is presented as organized position sets (patterns) for candidate entries.
